name: Youth Convention
summary: A week in God's Word, worship and community for CRCA young adults aged 16 to 28. Convention 2027 is sold out, with a waitlist open.

body.heading: Convention 2027 is sold out
paragraphs: Convention 2027 is full. You can still register to be added to the waitlist.

body.heading: What Convention is
paragraphs: Convention exists to bring together the young adults of the CRCA for a week in God's Word, worship and community. With a focus on personal discipleship, it serves as a "spiritual reset" for the year ahead.
Convention seeks to support the local church in raising up young people who will be lifelong, disciple-making disciples of Jesus.
The week includes plenty of time opening God's Word, worshipping together, hanging out at the village and some fun activities.

body.heading: The 2027 theme
paragraphs: Through the book of Ephesians, Convention 2027 looks at the union of Christ and his Church. The church is not just a human organisation, but a God-given organism, powered by his Spirit.
This shapes our identity, our purpose, our relationships and our future, both individually and together. Those who are "in Christ" are both recipients and channels of God's grace.

body.heading: Keynote speaker: Murray Capill
paragraphs: Murray Capill works at Reformed Theological College in Melbourne, where he helps train the next generation of pastors and gospel workers. He regularly speaks at camps and conferences.
Murray grew up in New Zealand. He is married to Wendy, and they have five adult children and quite a few grandchildren.

body.heading: Getting there and what it costs
paragraphs: Convention runs from the afternoon of Monday 11 January to the morning of Saturday 16 January 2027 at Busselton Baptist Camping Centre, Busselton, WA. A free bus leaves Perth Airport at 2pm sharp on 11 January and returns there at 4pm on 16 January. Select the bus in your registration if you need a seat.

The cost is $599 ($549 early bird, which closed 30 June). It covers five nights' accommodation, all meals during Convention, the guest speakers and panellists, and some activities. Registrations close 30 November 2026.
Convention has a strict age policy of 16 to 28. Questions about the age policy go to admin@crcaconvention.au.
